_readme: Danger points for the Sheriff and On-Market scores (scripts/risk.py), set with the user 2026-11-21 from the county's 2023-25 sales (cheap buys followed 18 months). Penalties are negative, bonuses positive; they are added to the priority score. The On-Market page also has the price-vs-ARV check (sheriff bids are low by nature, so it is not used there).

area._note: Per municipality: market buys of $25k-150k from 2023 until 18 months ago, and how many were flipped within 18 months. Needs 30+ buys. Countywide it is about 4%.
